metadata.description: Open-source Polish anti-slop writing tools for Claude and Claude Code.

plugins.name: stop-slop-pl
plugins.description: Polish-language anti-slop writing skill. Rewrites AI-sounding, bureaucratic, generic, or translated-from-English Polish prose into natural, register-appropriate text while preserving facts, numbers, citations, and meaning. Triggers on odslopuj, zhumanizuj po polsku, usuń AI-owy styl, uprość, and similar requests.
